articles.title: BTS will not submit music for 2027 Grammys
articles.description: The announcement came after the Academy announced new categories, including best Asian pop music performance. Some fans viewed this as a racialized barrier for Asian performers.

articles.title: BTS say they won't submit their music for the 2027 Grammy Awards
